items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: Clarence started to play with me... the band from Baden-Rouge would pick him up.

ctx.x: Well we just, we just called, we just gave it that name. Just made it up. Well the, the Tromont player, the young fellow, he said, well let's change the name. And he gave that name, I think it's an angel name or something like that. So we went by that name for a small good wife, and then the band began to change again. At that time I began to train boys to play. You see, the minute, well Clarence started to play with me, and the minute he could play good, the band from Baden-Rouge would pick him up. I learned to…
Could you tell me that full names? Oh yeah.
